qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve spiky blond man, black/chartreuse shirt, gray shorts and chunky trainers. Chartreuse should retain high red/green with low blue; inspect keying and avoid cyan liquid. Review can count, main burst, title and native audio.
choreography:
IDENTITY: the exact wild-eyed pale adult man with spiky blond hair, dark under-eye shadows, black-and-chartreuse lightning-patterned shirt, gray knee-length shorts, white socks and chunky black/white/chartreuse sneakers. Keep his black-and-yellow-green drink can design abstract, without invented product names or logos. Original comic character, no costume transformation.
0–1.2s: establish his complete body. Three visibly empty crushed cans hover loosely behind him. He shakes a fourth unopened can with a recklessly delighted grin; its metal sides bulge and chatter under ridiculous pressure.
1.2–3.2s: extreme close-up of the pull-tab snapping open, followed immediately by a violent camera pullback. A HUGE opaque lemon-yellow and cream carbonation jet erupts like a cannon. He wrestles the ordinary-sized can with both hands while the jet becomes a thirty-foot corkscrew of thick illustrated liquid and dense bubbles. The recoil sends his entire body flying backward, legs pedaling wildly. Keep liquid warm yellow with strong black contour lines, not translucent cyan mist; leave pure cyan surrounding all effects.
3.2–4.8s: he finally swings the jet toward the three empty cans, which spin into a vertical stack far in front of him. One enormous concentrated pressure shot PUNCHES straight through the stack, crushing all three into a single silver-black puck with a huge yellow-orange impact star. Camera tracks the projectile into depth, hits a readable contact freeze, then snaps back through the dissipating jet. One dominant cannon BOOM with rattling metallic crush; no ground, scenery or fullscreen flash.
4.8–6s: the jet shuts off, and he snaps back to a full-body, knees-bent heroic pose with his shirt and hair blown backward. Exact title FOURTH CAN, NO PLAN slams in three bold stable comic lines under his face.
6–8s: he tries to raise one triumphant fist but it trembles comically; the tiny discarded pull-tab finally lands on his head with a ping. He looks up cross-eyed, still grinning, then holds the exhausted overcharged pose. Do not introduce another drink. SFX: rapid metal rattle, pull-tab crack, colossal pressurized jet, accelerated air rush, crushing cannon impact, fizzy shutdown and tiny final ping. No speech, music or familiar franchise sounds.
name: Energy Drink Freak

qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve worn green/cream varsity outfit, shorts 23, black leggings/knee brace, sneakers and basketball trophy. Review green keying, trophy continuity, limb anatomy and complete dunk contact.
choreography:
IDENTITY: the exact young adult brown-skinned male athlete with short black curls and chin stubble, worn forest-green varsity jacket with cream sleeves and existing R patch, gray shirt, dog-tag necklace, distressed green shorts with existing 23 marking, black compression leggings and knee brace, worn green/cream sneakers. Preserve his small gold basketball-player trophy. Keep existing R and 23 as costume marks only; no extra captions.
0–0.7s: full-body low-angle anticipation. He looks at the little trophy with fierce determination. The tiny ball held by its gold figurine pops free, expands into a regulation-sized warm orange basketball and drops into his other hand.
0.7–2.5s: explosive comeback leap. Camera yanks backward and upward as he rockets thirty feet through the cyan void, clutching the trophy in one hand and cocking the basketball behind his head with the other. The rim bends under the impact, a giant gold wing-shaped shield burst wraps around his shoulders, and the net whips into a long spiral. Brief readable slam contact, massive warm orange/cream impact star, powerful full-body anatomy.
2.5–3.5s: snap back to a proud full-body hero pose with the trophy raised. The distant ball contracts back into the trophy figurine's tiny hand as exact title ONE LAST SHOT slams below the athlete's face in two forceful comic lines.
3.5–5s: he basks for a beat, then the trophy figurine tilts loose on its base. He quickly straightens it with one finger and gives the viewer a stubborn confident nod. Hold the comeback shield as two finite gold arcs behind him and keep text stable. SFX: small trophy ping, explosive sneaker launch, roaring ascent, thunderous rim slam, net snap and tiny wobbling-metal rattle. No floor, crowd, scene, voice or music.

choreography:
IDENTITY: the exact brown-skinned young adult man with short hanging black braids under a black knit beanie, goatee, gold hoop earring and rectangular gold pendant, oversized purple bomber jacket, white shirt, very baggy faded blue jeans and purple/cream sneakers. Preserve the black wired microphone with silver mesh grille. Remove the reference's dark purple background; cyan remains uniform.
0–0.7s: establish his full body. He rises from his low crouch, gives the mic an arrogant little tap, and raises it overhead with absolute confidence. His mouth stays closed; this move has no rap performance or lyrics.

Enormous bass impact, sharp readable contact hold, broad pure cyan gaps around every object; no opaque panel or stage.
2.5–3.5s: snap-zoom back to him in the original one-knee pose as the cable recoils and the mic lands neatly in his hand. Exact title ONE MORE VERSE slams in two chunky comic lines below his face. A compact glowing gold waveform remains beside him, the lasting verse.
3.5–5s: he confidently presents the microphone; one tiny squeak of electronic feedback makes his eyebrow twitch. He taps the mic again and freezes in an unconvincingly cool pose. Speakers collapse away into the small waveform. Strong title hold. SFX: hollow mic tap, enormous falling whoosh, colossal mic-drop BOOM, one sub-bass pressure hit, cable zip and brief comic feedback squeak. choreography:
IDENTITY: the exact dark-skinned adult woman with short outward-radiating black locs, large round black glasses, hoop/drop earrings, loose cream off-shoulder T-shirt with blue-and-ochre abstract shapes, dark olive cargo joggers, red/white/black high-top sneakers and black cross-body bag. Preserve her thick black marker and white autograph board. The autograph is an abstract looping black signature mark, not a new readable name. Keep reference costume intact.
0–0.7s: whole-character excited anticipation. She spots her imaginary idol beyond camera, hugs the autograph board close, then snaps it outward with a triumphant grin and sweeps the marker across its existing signature.
0.7–2.5s: the board UNFOLDS into a gigantic accordion paper fan, thirty feet wide in forced perspective, white panels with sweeping black signature strokes and bold warm rose-gold edges. Camera rockets backward to reveal the ridiculous scale and her tiny whole body firmly gripping its base. She delivers one full-body overhead fan swing that unleashes a colossal curling gust, carrying finite rose-and-gold heart-shaped paper cutouts in a powerful spiral. The gust surges past the camera with a huge ink-outlined impact star; its recoil lifts her into an exuberant midair kick. Keep the fan's complete outer contour and cyan margins visible; the fan is a physical foreground prop, never a wall or background panel.
2.5–3.5s: camera snap-zooms toward her delighted face as the giant fan folds rapidly back into the original autograph board. Exact title DAY ONE slams below her face in two large stable comic lines.
3.5–5s: settle into a full-body pose, autograph held proudly forward. A single heart-shaped paper cutout sticks to one glasses lens; she blows it away without losing her excited smile, then taps the autograph protectively with her marker. No new people or other words. SFX: marker squeak, thunderous paper unfolding, immense fanning WHUMP, rushing air and paper flutter, crisp folding snap and a tiny final lens tap. No speech, cheering or music.
